about: The researched entries of EnforcementAircraft. Additions only: an entry leaves the list only when it is found NOT to be involved, and then stays here with status cleared and the reason.

entries.name: Federal law-enforcement registrants
entries.rule: Every aircraft in the FAA Releasable Aircraft Database registered to a federal law-enforcement agency (Department of Homeland Security and its components, Customs and Border Protection, Immigration and Customs Enforcement, the Department of Justice and its components, the US Marshals Service), or to a contractor operator named in contractor_operators. A private registrant is named there only when a cited document backs it.

evidence.what: Registered to the agency, or to its named contractor operator, in the FAA aircraft registry.

entries.name: Texas Department of Public Safety, Aircraft Operations Division
owner_names: DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC SAFETY OF THE STATE OF TEXAS

evidence.what: Texas governor's Operation Lone Star release: DPS aircraft helped apprehend 15 people, all referred to Border Patrol.
A DPS helicopter flew overhead during a Liberty County Precinct 4 Constable operation with ICE; the people it spotted were caught and turned over to ICE.

FAA registry: the Department also registers aircraft as TEXAS DEPT OF PUBLIC SAFETY, at its Aircraft Operations address, 10335 Golfcourse Rd, Austin, where its aircraft under its full name are registered (N191TX and N556TX, AS350B3; N215TX, Cessna 208; registry download of 2026-11-01).

entries.name: Avelo Boeing 737-800 N801XT, hex AAE7B3

evidence.what: Avelo began ICE charter flights from Mesa Gateway (AZA) with three Boeing 737-800s, N801XT, N804VL and N805VL, repainted all white without Avelo's titles.
Human Rights First counted more than 1,900 ICE flights by Avelo from May to December 2025.
N801XT was the first Avelo aircraft on ICE flights, by Flightradar24 data, painted white.
FAA registry: N801XT is registered to BANK OF UTAH TRUSTEE, a Boeing 737-800.

cleared.why: Avelo closed its Mesa Gateway base on 2026-01-27 and ended its part in the DHS charter program. Flight trackers show its white 737-800s back on Avelo's scheduled passenger flights in mid-2026, and no ICE flight by them after January was found (searched 2026-10-29). Cleared as no longer involved, not as never involved.
